author: Chengxuan YUAN
prior_exposure_disclosure: Before model development, the initial source inventory printed pooled descriptive statistics over all 180 scenarios, without strategy returns or scenario-level policy diagnostics. Final scenarios were not used to fit, select or revise policies. Formal development parses returns only for requested IDs below121. Do not call this a completely pristine holdout.
review_pending: No further trades or target changes; score every remaining year. No simulated human alpha.
architecture_selection: Enable S3_review only if validation paired mean delta J versus S2_review has 95% percentile bootstrap lower bound >0, P90 MDD increase <=0.02 and P10 CAGR decrease <=0.0025; otherwise use S2_review. J=log(real terminal/100)-4*MDD. Thresholds are empirical screens, not statistical noninferiority guarantees.
severe_scenario_selection: Final scenario with largest S0 maximum real drawdown; all policies shown on that same path.
final_use: Refit weights and forecast distribution once on 1–120 after architecture choice. Freeze source/config/data hashes before parsing 121–180 returns. No tuning after final evaluation.
